notes: Generated from current registry/nodeDefinition; dynamic group interfaces depend on saved group data.
Legacy circle/rectangle/triangle kinds migrate to Shapes. Inlet is internal.
Numeric parameters expose param:<key> sockets; sample describes consumer sampling.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.description: An imported PNG, JPEG or WebP image. Connect it to a renderer’s Background to see actual glass refraction.

nodes.name: Circle
nodes.description: A resolution-independent circular path.

nodes.name: Editable Path
nodes.description: Editable vector anchors and Bézier handles. All downstream modifiers stay procedural.

nodes.name: Rectangle
nodes.description: A rounded rectangle, kept as an editable path.

nodes.name: Shapes
nodes.description: One procedural primitive source. Switch between Circle, Rectangle, Polygon and Star; each mode keeps its settings and uses the same downstream connections.

nodes.name: SVG Graphic
nodes.description: Imported, sanitised vector paths. Scale, transform, duplicate and modify them without rasterising the graph.

nodes.name: Triangle
nodes.description: A parametric three-sided path.

nodes.name: Copy
nodes.description: Create actual path instances with independent spacing and scale.

nodes.name: Deform
nodes.description: Move path points along their normals. Connect a Field to limit the effect.

nodes.name: Displace
nodes.description: Sample any connected value at each path point and displace it. Neutral value keeps the original contour; the optional field limits the effect.

nodes.name: Outline
nodes.description: Turn a filled path into an outline. Geometry stays editable.

nodes.name: Resample
nodes.description: Add evenly spaced points before deformation, including along straight edges. Lower spacing gives finer detail at a higher evaluation cost.

nodes.name: Transform
nodes.description: Translate, rotate and scale incoming paths.

nodes.name: Trim Path
nodes.description: Reveal a percentage of the path, with a movable starting point.

nodes.name: Box Field
nodes.description: A rotated rectangular mask and outward normals. Its weight can drive any numeric attribute.

nodes.name: Linear Field
nodes.description: A directional gradient mask in canvas space.

nodes.name: Radial Field
nodes.description: A spatial mask and direction. Only connected nodes use this field.

nodes.name: Shape Field
nodes.description: Use any incoming path as a custom field. Filled area or distance from its contour supplies the mask.

nodes.name: Math
nodes.description: Combine reusable values or field weights. Multiply Noise by a field to localise its influence.

nodes.name: Noise
nodes.description: One reusable, seeded smooth pattern. Sample it in space, along a path, per copy or uniformly. Connect Time to retime it independently.

nodes.name: Random
nodes.description: Stable seeded values for each copy, path sample or spatial cell. Scrubbing and export do not reshuffle the result.

nodes.name: Remap
nodes.description: Give a shared pattern a destination-specific range. The upstream Noise and every other connection stay independent.

nodes.name: Time
nodes.description: The same deterministic time used by playback, scrubbing and export. Drive evolution or a numeric parameter through Math and Remap.

nodes.name: Gradient
nodes.description: Map a shared value into colours. With no Value connected, use the regular image gradient.

nodes.name: LFO
nodes.description: Drive numeric attributes with a repeating value. An optional Time input retimes this signal independently.

nodes.name: Glass Material
nodes.description: A refractive screen-space material. Thickness, IOR, roughness, transmission and reflection accept shared procedural values.

nodes.name: Contour Colour Pulse
nodes.description: A colour and opacity wave travels outward from the contour, with a smooth attack and release.

nodes.name: Silhouette Spread
nodes.description: Light travels from the silhouette along its normals. Plug this reusable effect stack into Optical or Fluid.

nodes.name: Tip Emission
nodes.description: Emit directional light from actual open-path endpoints and tangents. Trim Path preserves the endpoints used here.

nodes.name: Venetian Ribs
nodes.description: Refractive ribs warp the silhouette and light. Neighbouring ribs can sample different times, in straight or outward-normal directions.

nodes.name: Fluid
nodes.description: An advected 2D fluid with pressure projection, viscosity, vorticity and dye transport. Seeking rebuilds a deterministic cache from time zero.

nodes.name: Optical
nodes.description: Render editable paths as light, with optional material, background and procedural effect inputs.

nodes.name: Node Group
nodes.description: A reusable subgraph with typed external connections and exposed parameters. Open the group to edit its complete internal graph.

nodes.name: Group Input
nodes.description: Receives a typed connection or exposed parameter from the containing group.

nodes.name: Mix
nodes.description: Combine two rendered image branches. Shape data cannot connect here.

nodes.name: Output
nodes.description: The final image. Pin it to keep seeing the result while editing upstream nodes.
